mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past month signals an imminent monetary easing, which reduces the risk-free rate and boosts equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS declines over the past month, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the housing starts (HOUST) exceed 1,350,000 units in the prior month, it signals strong consumer demand and economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST exceeds 1350.0 in the prior month but S&P 500 returns are negative in more than 60% of such instances, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4.0% and a rise in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) above 200,000 jobs signals a tight labor market that fuels consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint condition (UNRATE < 4.0 and PAYEMS > 200) occurs but S&P 500 returns are negative in more than 60% of cases, or the interaction term's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of declining industrial production (INDPRO < 100), supply chain disruptions intensify, leading to higher inflation and reduced corporate margins, which cause negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO < 100 but S&P 500 returns are positive in more than 60% of instances, or the Rank IC for the signal is below 0.03 over any 1-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) above 730,000 million dollars signals robust consumer demand, which supports corporate revenue growth and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: RSAFS exceeds 730,000 but S&P 500 returns are negative in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year CPI (CPIAUCSL) rises above 3.5%, it signals persistent inflation, prompting the Federal Reserve to maintain a restrictive monetary policy, which leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.5 but S&P 500 returns are positive in more than 60% of instances, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in CPIAUCSL YoY above 3.5% and a stable FEDFUNDS rate (within 0.25% of the current level) signals persistent inflation without monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint condition (CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.5 and FEDFUNDS within 0.25% of current) occurs but S&P 500 returns are positive in more than 60% of cases, or the interaction term's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 1-year window.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-unemployment regime (UNRATE > 5.0%), labor market weakness reduces consumer spending and corporate hiring, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE > 5.0 but S&P 500 returns are positive in more than 60% of instances, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year window.
